```lean
theorem lg_target {G : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup G] [LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] [AddCommGroup H] [PartialOrder H] [IsOrderedAddMonoid H] {f : G → H} (h₁ : ∀ (x : G), f (-x) = -f x) (h₂ : StrictMonoOn f (Set.Ici 0)) : StrictMono f := by
  intro x y
  intros h : x < y
  have h0 : 0 ≤ x := le_rfl
  have h1 : 0 ≤ y := le_rfl
  have h2 : x ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by apply Set.Ici.2; exact h0
  have h3 : y ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by apply Set.Ici.2; exact h1
  have h4 : f x < f y := StrictMonoOn.strict_mono_on_apply h₂ h2 h3
  exact h4
```
